company.description:
Maven offers an enterprise software-as-a-service platform that enables businesses to connect and obtain insights from experts in the industry. It provides tools and solutions that enable its customers to build and manage communities of experts and professionals. It offers its services for consumer goods; industrial products and services; healthcare and biomedical; technology; venture capital and private equity; business development; human resource; information technology; knowledge management; marketing; and research and development sectors.

Maven offers features that enable businesses to connect and obtain insights from employees and alumni to develop internal collaboration. The company also provides tools that facilitate electronic surveys, telephone consultations, virtual ideation panels, workshops, seminars, research, analysis, and in-person engagements.

Maven was founded by Mark S. Platosh, Wyatt A. Nordstrom, and Anthony J. D'Alessandro in February 2008. It is based in San Francisco, California.
